name: Tsubureta Hitomi de Boku o Miro
source:
Kyouya and Suzu were brothers. Despite being bound by blood, they desired each other.

Kyouya made love to Suzu and vice versa. He raped him, and got raped by him.
They knew it wasn't normal. They were disgusted in themselves, and yet, Kyouya couldn't find it in himself to reject Suzu.

It was his way of atonement.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ320441.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
响也与铃是一对兄弟。尽管血脉相连，他们却彼此渴求。

响也与铃做爱，也被铃占有。他侵犯弟弟，也遭弟弟侵犯。
他们知道这并不正常，也对自己感到厌恶。可即便如此，响也仍无法拒绝铃。

因为，那是他赎罪的方式。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ320441.html]DLsite[/url]]
